    StartersTeahouse dumplingsSteamed pork and cabbage dumplings with black vinegar and chilli oilHow to make it400g pork mince2 cups of shredded wombok1 tbsp grated ginger2 spring onions30 dumpling wrappers2 tbsp Chinkiang vinegar1 tbsp chilli oilMix the pork with wombok, ginger and spring onions.Fill the wrappers and pleat.Steam in bamboo baskets.Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.Desert lamb skewersCumin and chilli lamb skewers, Lo and Jen's desert caveHow to make it600g lamb shoulder, diced2 tsp cumin seeds, crushed, plus extra to serve1 tsp chilli flakes1 tsp sea salt flakesToss the lamb with cumin, chilli flakes and salt.Thread onto skewers.Grill hot until charred at the edges.Sprinkle with more cumin to serve.Bamboo forest garlic greensThe fight on top of the bamboo forestHow to make itAs written, serves 4Baby bok choy, snow peas and bamboo shoots stir-fried fast in a smoking wok with garlic, oyster sauce and sesame oil, served in a bamboo steamer basket.Halve 4 baby bok choy and trim 150g snow peas.Drain a 225g tin of bamboo shoots.Heat a wok until smoking, add 2 tbsp oil and 4 sliced garlic cloves and stir 10 seconds.Add the bok choy stems, snow peas and bamboo shoots and toss 1 minute, then the leaves with a splash of water.Add 2 tbsp oyster sauce and a few drops of sesame oil, toss and serve in a bamboo basket.Sesame and spring onion flatbreadLo took the comb. Jen wants this back too.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsYu Shu Lien's steamed whole fishWhole snapper steamed with ginger, topped with soy, spring onion and sizzling oilHow to make it1.2kg whole snapper1 knob ginger1 bunch spring onions1 bunch coriander3 tbsp soy sauce4 tbsp vegetable oilScore the snapper and slice the ginger and spring onions.Lay the fish on sliced ginger and spring onion.Steam until the flesh flakes.Pile shredded spring onion and coriander on top.Pour over soy, then smoking hot oil so it sizzles.Peking-style crisp duck with pancakesGovernor Yu's table, Jade Fox as governessHow to make itAs written, serves 4Duck legs salted overnight and roasted until the skin crackles, shredded into steamed pancakes with cucumber, spring onion and sweet hoisin.Rub 4 duck legs with 2 tsp salt and a little five spice and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.Roast skin up on a rack at 180°C for 90 minutes, then at 220°C for 10 minutes until crisp.Shred with two forks.Steam 20 Chinese pancakes for 3 minutes.Cut a cucumber and 4 spring onions into thin batons.Serve everything with a bowl of hoisin to build your own.SweetsGreen Destiny sesame ballsFried red bean rice balls in sesame. The sword breaks every blade.How to make it250g glutinous rice flour60g caster sugar200ml hot water200g red bean paste3 tbsp sesame seeds1.5 L vegetable oil, for fryingMix the rice flour and sugar with hot water into a dough.Wrap the dough around small balls of red bean paste.Roll in sesame seeds.Heat the oil to 160°C and fry in batches until puffed and golden.DrinksTeahouse jasmine pearl green teaJasmine pearl green tea in a pot, small cups. Make a wish, Lo.How to make it1 L water4 tsp jasmine pearl green tea1 packet dried longanHeat the water to about 80°C, or boil it and leave it to stand for 5 minutes.Warm a teapot with hot water and tip it out.Add the tea, pour over the water and steep.Pour into small cups and refill the pot for a second and third steep.Serve a bowl of dried longan on the side.Warm osmanthus wineFor the Invincible Sword Goddess. Mind the furniture.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
